issueReference.title: Complete the Work Runtime P1 dependency DAG

reviewContext.userProblem: Complete the accepted Work Runtime P1-0 through P1-8 dependency DAG from checkpoint bf39f374 without treating retained source as verified implementation, bypassing predecessor gates, or absorbing unrelated work.
requiredOutcomes: Certify or repair the canonical implementation/documentation node sandbox behavior and implement atomic reservation, launch fencing, durable pending requests, and cancellation acknowledgment.
Implement durable guard evidence, deterministic director ordering, store-authoritative completion, causal decision application, replay safety, and fail-closed cancellation behavior.
Implement reachable-node capability requirements, bounded host probes, deterministic placement, host-aware validation and planner inputs before dispatch reservation.
Implement task run, side-effect-free dry-run, task decide, bounded agent-director execution, replacement examples, then remove workflow auto-improve only after equivalent behavior passes.

Serially reconcile the joined tree, run focused and proportional aggregate verification, obtain independent reviews, refresh narrow documentation/indexes/digests, and prepare the accepted commit/push allowlist.
nonGoals: Do not implement P2-P7, loop-engineering, agent-node-output-contract, workflow-defect detection, Tauri, note plans, task serve, GraphQL task/host APIs, GUI, proposal/replanning machinery, specialist classification, or capability ceilings.
Do not add legacy auto-improve migration/compatibility, implicit task creation for plain workflow run, a new planner, a new credential system, or speculative abstraction.
Do not edit the installed user-scope workflow package, create worktrees, integrate a base branch, or modify unrelated and Monja tenant-sharding-d48 work.
constraints: Use only the immutable installed user-scope codex-design-and-implement-review-loop package and this working directory on feat/remaining-impl-plans.
Preserve unrelated tracked, untracked, and staged state; use exact scoped writes, immutable intent records, pre-write drift checks, one owner per overlapping file, and serial repair for shared files.

Admit a dependent plan only after every predecessor has accepted implementation, complete behavioral logs with final exit 0 and positive test counts, exact interface/source handoff, and integration review with no unresolved high or mid finding.
Workers edit only their own progress file; shared indexes, lockfiles, package digests, broad formatting, plan reconciliation, commit, and push are serial finalization work.

Run commands in the foreground, poll yielded sessions through exit, and retain complete logs and final exit statuses under tmp/work-runtime-p1-dag-20260922-session-1-checkpoint with per-plan and per-attempt directories.
designDecisionsAndRationale: Reservation is the commit point so the task version and dependency recheck, attempt, unique workflow session, lease, decision/request, placement evidence, and task advancement commit or roll back together.
TaskDispatcher owns orchestration while the existing workflow runner owns execution, preserving the RielaCore-to-RielaWork dependency direction and executing exactly the reserved session.
The full typed guard batch is persisted before deterministic, human, or agent decisions so replay, accounting, and causality are durable and inspectable.
The director uses a stable priority of budget, convergence, inactivity, recoverable failure or gate rejection, completion, then wait-human so one snapshot produces one decision.

Policy, human, and agent decisions share one store-backed applier so completion reconstruction, causal scope, optimistic concurrency, replay, pending requests, and cancellation acknowledgment cannot diverge.
One reachable-node projection and one fresh merged capability snapshot determine deterministic per-node placement before reservation; host validation never authorizes a later launch.
The obsolete auto-improve path is removed only after dispatcher replacement behavior and deterministic task-backed examples pass, in the same publication cut as the replacement CLI.
intentionalTradeoffs: Explicit backend enablement may remain usable but unverified after an absent or failed probe; the failure remains visible and never becomes authenticated evidence.
Same-directory dependency-ready fanout is retained with disjoint ownership, immutable intent and hash evidence, serial shared-file reconciliation, and independent combined-tree review.
Host validation is read-only and advisory unless strict-host is requested; dispatch independently refreshes and evaluates placement before reservation.
No browser E2E gate is required because the accepted P1 plans change no web code.
supportedEdgeCases: Independent-connection reservation races, rollback at transactional insertion boundaries, stale task versions, missing versus unmet dependencies, duplicate attempt/session IDs, and terminal-but-unreconciled fencing.
Wrong, replayed, replaced, or uncertain launch tokens; pre/post-authorization crashes; stale terminal writers; one-time rerun/recover consumption; and lost cancellation acknowledgment.
Simultaneous guard violations, exact budget/time boundaries, last-admitted-attempt completion, replay deduplication, repeated-finding fingerprints, and official SDK heartbeat exemption.
Pins and ordered fallback, unknown/stale capabilities, failed refresh, explicit hosts, worker groups, unavailable capacity, called-workflow cycles, unreachable nodes, and unknown model support.
Dry-run with absent, incompatible, or corrupt stores/configuration without creating, migrating, quarantining, caching, or mutating state; decision replay conflicts and interrupted execution.
outOfScopeEdgeCases: Migration of legacy loop, routine, specialist, event, supervision, or auto-improve records.
Repository-context worktrees/finalization, GraphQL task/host mutations, Studio or Task-board UI, proposals/replanning, capability ceilings, and task serve.
Live credentials as a deterministic verification prerequisite, backend prompt translation, or cross-backend behavioral-equivalence guarantees.
residualRisks: Implementation and behavioral verification remain downstream gates.
Publication requires fresh live-origin and upstream verification.

acceptanceCriteria: P1-0 retains or narrowly repairs workspace-write for only canonical Step 6 and Step 8 while surrounding intake/review nodes stay read-only and accepted-plan/review prompt boundaries remain unchanged.
Canonical bundle validation and the real-payload regression pass without executing the project-scope workflow or editing the installed user-scope package.
Build, positive-count focused tests, strict touched-file lint, repository lint comparison, and diff hygiene have complete foreground evidence.

reserveAttempt uses one BEGIN IMMEDIATE transaction to recheck version/dependencies/budget/fence and atomically create the attempt, unique session snapshot, lease, decision/request, placement evidence, and task advancement, with rollback at every injected boundary.

One-use digest-only launch authorization, uncertain-launch fencing, stale terminal writer rejection, one-time rerun/recover consumption, and durable cancellation acknowledgment pass independent-connection behavioral tests.
Finalized reservation/cancellation/request signatures and accepted source hashes are recorded for lifecycle and capabilities before either dependent plan starts.

requirements: Use independent SQLite connections for concurrency cases and record complete foreground logs, final exit status, selected test names, and positive per-suite counts.

P1-3a applies stable budget, convergence, inactivity, recoverable failure/gate rejection, completion, then wait-human ordering with remaining-attempt checks and no budget bypass.

Every ordering row, equality boundary, causal failure, replay conflict field, crash window, and cancellation state passes focused behavioral tests without lifecycle editing reservation-owned schema/model files.

requirements: Consume accepted reservation signatures, run in the foreground, and retain final exit status, complete log path, selected tests, and positive per-suite counts.

Explicit pins never fall back; assignment/group/liveness/capacity constraints are authoritative; failed refresh cannot reuse stale success; absent/corrupt validation and dry-run inputs remain read-only.

The finalized resolver/probe/placement interfaces, accepted source hashes, and positive focused suite evidence are recorded before dispatch starts.

P1-6b dry-run performs equivalent resolution while leaving database bytes/rows, WAL/SHM, work_hosts, caches, host configuration, absent stores, and corrupt profiles unchanged.

V0-V9, self-review, test-integrity, the single material adversarial review, and combined-tree review produce complete logs, positive required counts, and no unresolved high or mid finding.

Every command runs in the foreground with command/start/end/final exit/complete log and positive per-suite counts; zero selected tests, incomplete logs, timeout, or unpolled sessions fail.

acceptanceCriteria: P1-8a joins every accepted predecessor using runtime change evidence, immutable intents, and pre/post hashes; one serial owner repairs lost/overwritten intent and reruns affected gates before combined-tree review.

P1-8b reconciles help, README, SurfaceCatalog, parity design, workflow authoring guidance, all six plans, progress/index artifacts, and P1 status only from accepted implementation evidence while marking P5 counterparts deferred.

P1-8c audits every owning riela-package.json for workflow/prompt/script/skill edits, refreshes only applicable digests with the established tool, or records a fresh no-owner result; lockfile/index/formatting work stays serial.

P1-8d runs focused and full aggregate gates, strict lint on the accepted union, repository lint comparison, removed-surface classification, self-review, Sol's single material adversarial review, and Astra's combined-tree review with no unresolved high or mid finding.

Only accepted P1 implementation and narrowly required documentation/index updates enter the final exact commit allowlist; publication performs fresh live-origin/upstream checks and never force-pushes.
